description: English is the fallback donor for pl, ru, ar, fr and pt requests, and its Items.Fallback entry declares ONLY CARDINALITY_ONE and CARDINALITY_OTHER. That makes the fixture an asymmetric detector: under correct behavior every count resolves under English rules to ONE or OTHER and succeeds, while an implementation that evaluated under the REQUESTING locale would select FEW / MANY / ZERO / TWO, find no branch, raise the 'Missing Cardinality translation' IllegalStateException, and -- because the default TranslationFallbackPolicy does not fall past a RESOLUTION_FAILURE -- return the key. Rank.Fallback declares all six ordinality constants so English's ONE/TWO/FEW ordinal categories (which pl, ru, ar and pt do not have at all) are observable through a fallback as text rather than as a throw.

Items.Fallback.commentary: Deliberately only the two categories English actually has, which is what a real shipped English catalog looks like.
